editorial:
Imagine you just finished your service in the military and all you want is to relax with your wife. That is exactly where you start with this flick. You get to follow a tough former marine who finds himself in a nightmare when some bad guys steal a pile of diamonds and kidnap his wife to cover their tracks. The whole movie feels like a classic chase story. It takes place in the thick woods of South Carolina, giving the story a rugged, outdoorsy feel. It is not trying to be a deep drama; it is just about a husband who will do anything to get his partner back, and it keeps you leaning in to see how he handles the odds.

What really makes this work is the action. The fights are punchy and the pacing stays fast so you never get bored. While the plot is pretty simple, the grit makes it feel real. If you love old-school action heroes who take names and kick butt, you will have a blast. It is a great choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon. You can grab it by renting it on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: At the end, the marine tracks the thieves to their hideout for a final showdown. After a series of brutal fights in the wilderness, he manages to take down the gang leader and save his wife. He uses his military training to outsmart the criminals one by one. Once the bad guys are defeated and the police arrive, he and his wife finally get to be together in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic rescue missions and tough-guy action movies.
